The logic must support two teams with a maximum of one player each. Upon team fulfillment, spawn a volleyball that players can hit over the net. If the ball contacts the ground, despawn it, award a point to the opposing team, and declare the first to reach five points the winner.", "B": "Hey, can you help me write the client and server Lua files for a FiveM volleyball script? It needs to let two players pick teams, one per side. Once both are ready, spawn a ball that they can hit over the net. If it touches the ground, despawn it, give a point to the other team, and the first to five wins."}
